heading: Today
text: Mostly cloudy. Chance of a morning shower north, then increasing chances south into the afternoon with the potential for scattered storms. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s, some upper 70s far south. South wind 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 35 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy. Rain showers with a chance for thunderstorms. Lows in the low to mid 60s. Wind becoming southwest at 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 20 mph, with higher gusts expected in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Thursday
text: A few lingering showers, otherwise partly cloudy. Highs from the mid 70s to near 80 degrees. West wind 10 to 15 mph, occasionally gusting to 25 mph.
